items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: Oh, Delby. Jacob. Delby was in, where's his name? I tried, I wrote them, but that house is closed.

ctx.x: And they had marches from out of town or did they arrange them themselves?

No, they'd get marches from the houses. Such as Pepper, Barnhouse, Jenkins, and Southwell, and what's this other house now? I can't think of the other house now. Oh, Delby. Jacob. Delby was in, where's his name? I tried, I wrote them, but that house is closed. Oh, it's right across the river from Omaha, Nebraska. It's right on the end of my tongue and I can't close it.
We can find it. We'll look at a map. What is the difference between those brass bands of that day and the ones of today?
